nina: Quick check: legacy prepay account 'DataGrid Inc' has a leftover deferred balance of $6,500 tied to a cancelled pilot that ended 2024-11. Billing says they stopped usage in Dec and we never issued a refund or final credit. What do we do for close?
carlos: If contract terminated and refund due, we should either refund or reclassify to other income per policy. Did sales sign an early termination agreement?
faizal: I pulled the opp (ID 00321). Termination email exists but no signed amendment. Legal suggests we can issue a goodwill credit but need approval. Amount small but auditors want a paper trail.
recon-bot: Alert: deferred revenue rollback candidate identified: acct DataGrid Inc, def_bal 6,500, orig_rev_sched rev_sched_2024_089.
nina: For month-end, propose we create a liability for customer refunds and process CM-2026-03-DG1. JE: 
```
Dr Deferred Revenue - DataGrid 6,500
Cr Customer Refund Liability 6,500
```
Then when credit memo issued/ refund paid: 
```
Dr Customer Refund Liability 6,500
Cr Cash/Bank 6,500
```
carlos: Approve. Also add note: if sales doesn't want to refund, we need exec approval to reclassify to other income. Keep thread open until resolved.
faizal: I'll draft the credit memo and attach termination email. Recon team, please tag the JE with rev_sched_2024_089.
recon-bot: JE created: JE-2026-03-DG1. Attachments required: termination email, opp screenshot.
nina: Posted JE and CM draft. Closing note to close tracker: "DataGrid deferred balance cleared to refund liability; pending CM issuance." :white_check_mark:
